description:
Confusion-matrix figure for one execution: heatmap with trial
counts + per-class accuracy bars, rendered as a PNG the assistant can
see. Use it right after execution.results to eyeball WHICH classes are
confused, not just the accuracy number.

matrix.description:
"eval" (held-out, default) or "train" (fit-set / cross-validation).
CV and evaluation-plan runs often have no eval matrix — use "train".

save.description: Also write the PNG to NIMBUS_EXPORT_DIR/plots/ and return its path.

name: plots.confusion

meta.description: Figure sidecar. foundation.compare includes results/best/skipped (also as a JSON text content block).

title: Plots.Confusion
